about_the_game:
A kit with Assault Volk in his Vega Legendary Outfit, procured primary and secondary weapons as well as Coins and days of Premium.

This kit contains:

 

  • Assault Volk from the Vympel collection:

Volk is armed with an AK-74M with a 30-round magazine. While the ability is active, the operator’s recoil is decreased and the shooting accuracy of the primary weapon is improved. His special gear is a GP-25 under-barrel grenade launcher.

 

  • Vega Legendary Outfit for Volk:

An alternative outfit for the operator. Increases operator’s XP gain by 25%.

 

  • AKS-74UB assault rifle for Volk:

A procured primary weapon for the operator. Can be applied in operator settings.

 

  • PB pistol for Volk:

A procured secondary weapon for the operator. Can be applied in operator settings.

 

  • 20,000 Coins:

Coins can be spent on operators, customization items, and progress boosting.

 

  • 30 days of Premium:

Premium speeds up in-game progress and unlocks Premium objectives.

— +20% XP if all teammates have active Premium.

— +10% XP for all teammates.

— +100% XP in all types of combat.

— +30% XP in the new Battle Pass.

— Increases gained Karma Points by 20%.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence, Cruelty or Gore.
